steps.npc: It's not often that we see more humans in this place.

options.text: How did you come to be here?

steps.player: How did you come to be here?

steps.npc: General Hining sent us out in a scouting party. We got separated from the rest, and became completely lost. Soon we ran out of rations.
Eventually we stumbled upon this place. They saw we were starving, and allowed us to eat of their sacred eels if we vowed to serve Zulrah.
Since then, we've settled here. We went back up north once, to see how the king's campaign was going, but they drove us out of the camp, calling us unclean.
It's probably the sacred eels that did it. They change you, you know. Once you've tasted them, you're part of the tribe forever.
